opening: 为什么两笔订单的130元，会算成220元？
Why do two orders worth130 become220?

title: 先看多出的90元
Find the extra90
lead: 问题不在加法，而在参加加法的记录变了。
The addition is correct; the rows being added have changed.
paragraphs: 你会按订单编号查明细、做简单求和，就可以开始。订单表里U是90元、V是40元，总额130元。明细表里U有两条记录，V还没有记录。我们想把明细放到订单旁边，但仍按每笔订单统计金额。
Start with looking up an order ID and summing amounts. U is90 and V40,total130. U has two line records; V has none. We want line information beside orders while reporting one amount per order.
同一份报表却出现总额220元。先看原始两表，猜测LEFT JOIN会得到几行：连接是否会改写金额，还是会重复带入订单？这里先不展示关联结果。
The report totals220 instead.Inspect the two source tables and predict the LEFT JOIN row count.Does joining change an amount or repeat an order?The joined output is deliberately withheld here.
写下预测并核对后，再到下一段追踪U和V的匹配。保留这个疑问：业务要的是每单一次，结果的一行却可能不再代表一单。
Record and check a prediction,then trace U/V matches in the next section.Keep the question:the business counts each order once,but an output row may no longer represent one order.

title: 一条订单怎样匹配明细
How one order matches lines
lead: 先说清“一行代表什么”，再决定怎么连接。
Declare what one row means before deciding how to join.
paragraphs: 订单表一行代表一笔订单，明细表一行代表一条明细，这叫记录粒度。order_id是用来寻找同一笔订单的关联键。它在订单表中不重复，不代表它在明细表中也不重复。
An order row represents one order; a line row represents one line. This is row grain. order_id is the join key for the same order. Its uniqueness in orders does not imply uniqueness in lines.
o和l是orders与lines的短别名，不是新列。ON o.order_id=l.order_id 对每一对行判断编号是否相等。U匹配两行，所以输出两行，这是“一对多”。V匹配零行；LEFT JOIN仍保留V，并在右侧填NULL。NULL表示这里没有右侧值，不是数字0。

o and l are short aliases for orders and lines,not new columns. ON o.order_id=l.order_id compares each pair of IDs. U matches two rows:one-to-many. V matches none; LEFT JOIN retains V with null right values. NULL is the absence of a value,not the number zero.
在原始表先数每个编号的记录，再预估连接后的行数。本例U贡献2行，V的无匹配保留行贡献1行，所以一共3行。这个估计能在写复杂查询之前暴露金额可能放大的风险。
Count records per key before joining. U contributes2 rows and unmatched V contributes1,so expect3. This prediction can reveal inflation before a complicated query is written.

title: 先汇总，让一单只占一行
Aggregate back to one row per order
lead: 修正明细的粒度，而不是在结果里随手删重复。
Fix the detail grain rather than deleting apparent duplicates.
paragraphs: 目标是每单一行，先把明细按order_id分组，把同单的line_amount相加。得到U=30；V没有明细，所以这个汇总表里没有V。此时每个可匹配编号至多一行。 GROUP BY把同编号放在一组，SUM在每组内求和；这一步把两条U明细变成一个U结果。

Group lines by order_id and sum line_amount. This gives U=30; V is absent because it has no lines. Each matching ID now has at most one row. GROUP BY groups equal IDs and SUM adds within each group,turning two U lines into one U result.
WITH per_order AS (...) 给这个中间结果起名字。再从orders做LEFT JOIN：U得到30，V仍保留NULL。订单金额90和40各出现一次，合计回到130。右侧切换两种查询，逐行对照结果而不是只看最终总额。

WITH per_order AS (...) names the intermediate result. LEFT JOIN from orders now yields U30 and retains V with NULL. Order amounts90 and40 appear once,total130. Switch queries and compare rows,not only the final total.
为什么不用SUM(DISTINCT order_amount)？不同订单可能恰好金额相同，按金额去重会把真实订单丢掉。应该检查订单键，而不是用金额猜身份。也不要未经约定把NULL填0：没有明细与明细尚未上报可能有不同业务含义。

Why not SUM(DISTINCT order_amount)? Different orders can have the same amount,so amount deduplication loses real orders. Check order identity. Do not replace NULL with zero without deciding whether missing lines mean none or not-yet-reported.

title: 筛选放在连接前还是后
Filter matches or completed rows
lead: “保留所有订单”与“只要大于15的明细”要分开表达。
Separate retaining all orders from selecting line amounts above15.
paragraphs: 把l.line_amount>15放在ON中，是限制哪些明细可以匹配。U只匹配20，V仍得到一条无匹配的保留行。条件放在WHERE中，则先完成连接，再删掉不满足条件的输出行。
In ON,l.line_amount>15 restricts matching lines. U matches20; V still receives a preserved unmatched row. WHERE instead filters already-joined output rows.
V右侧是NULL。NULL>15不是“真”，所以WHERE会删掉V。观察右侧两种输出：同样一个条件，保留的订单集合变了。想找无匹配记录时用IS NULL，不用= NULL。
For V,the right side is NULL. NULL>15 is not true,so WHERE removes V. Compare the preserved order sets. To find unmatched values,use IS NULL,not = NULL.
最后同时核对行数、不同订单数、保留了哪些编号以及金额总量。一个正确的总额不能单独证明关联正确；两个错误也可能碰巧抵消。本站运行器使用SQLite，展示这部分公共SQL语义；PostgreSQL的类型、排序规则和执行计划仍要在目标环境复核。 COUNT(*)数输出行，COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)数不同订单编号。

Reconcile rows,distinct order IDs,preserved keys and totals together. A total alone cannot prove a join correct because errors can cancel. The runner uses SQLite for shared SQL semantics; verify PostgreSQL types,collations and plans in its environment. COUNT(*) counts output rows;COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) counts distinct order IDs.

title: 复核后，用新订单再试
Check it,then try new orders
lead: 能解释变化，再把方法迁移到新的输入。
Explain the transformation,then transfer the method.
paragraphs: 先完成右侧的小检查：它只反馈这个示例的行数推断，不授叶。进入练习后会换订单和金额，你需要写查询、运行、核对输出，并说明一个仍需验证的边界。
The small check on the right only verifies this example prediction; it awards no leaves. Practice changes orders/amounts:write a query,run it,inspect output and explain one remaining boundary.
独立练习会要求order_id、order_amount、line_total三个输出列，并明确无明细保留NULL。系统实际比较这份数据的结果，不会因查询写得长就认为正确。最终检验再使用不同记录检查方法选择和行数判断。

Independent practice requests order_id,order_amount,line_total with NULL for missing lines. The system compares actual output for this dataset,not query length. Final checks use different records for method selection and cardinality.

checkTopics: 选择保留订单的关联方法
Choosing a join that preserves orders
核对一对多的输出行数

opening: 会员与满额都免运费，要检查哪几种情况？
Both membership and spend waive shipping:which cases matter?

title: 先把规则说清楚
Clarify the rule
lead: “任一条件满足”与“两个都满足”，结果可能不同。
Either condition and both conditions are different rules.
paragraphs: 假设会员免运费；非会员订单满100元也免；其余收8元。这是本课合成规则，不是某平台政策。先看两个具体订单：会员买30元、非会员买120元，它们为什么都免运费？

Our synthetic rule:members ship free;nonmembers spending at least100 also ship free;others pay8. This is a teaching policy. Why do a member spending30 and a nonmember spending120 both pay zero shipping?
条件是能回答“是/否”的判断，例如“是会员吗”“金额达到100吗”。动作是系统要做什么，这里是收多少运费。把条件组合与动作写在一起，才能发现漏掉或相互矛盾的规则。
A condition is a yes/no decision such as membership or spend>=100. An action is what the system does:the shipping charge. Connecting combinations to actions reveals missing or contradictory rules.
用右侧输入换几种订单，先观察哪条规则适用。金额达到100，指100也算在内；这个端点要在后面单独检查。
Change the order on the right and observe the applicable rule. At least100 includes100; we will test that endpoint separately.

title: 补全组合，再填写动作
Build combinations and assign actions
lead: 有两项二值条件，就先展开四种可能。
Begin with four possibilities for two binary conditions.
paragraphs: 先固定“会员=是”，分别搭配金额达标和未达标；再固定“会员=否”，重复两种金额条件。这样有序地列出四种组合，比凭印象挑几个订单更不容易漏。
Hold membership true and try both spend conditions,then hold it false and repeat. This systematic enumeration is less likely to omit cases than choosing a few memorable orders.
现在只列条件，不先填答案。对每一行分别判断：是否已经有一个免运费条件成立？如果都不成立，才采用基本运费。填写后点击逐行核对，查看遗漏的位置。
List conditions before assigning answers.For each row,ask whether either waiver condition holds.Use the base fee only if neither holds.Fill the actions,then check rows to locate omissions.
四种组合在本例都可发生。其他问题若有不可能的组合，要写出排除依据，不能为了表格变短随便删行。“本例四组合覆盖”也不等于所有金额、身份和系统实现都已测试。

All four combinations are feasible here. In other tasks,justify infeasible combinations instead of deleting inconvenient rows. Covering these four does not test every amount,identity or implementation.
先尝试右侧四行。核对后再展开“合并规则与冲突处理”，区分无关条件、不可行组合和动作冲突。
Try the four rows first.After checking,open “Merging rules and resolving conflicts” to distinguish irrelevant conditions,infeasible combinations and conflicting actions.
afterCheck: 每个组合必须得到明确动作。会员两行均免运费；非会员达标免；非会员未达标收8。右侧将每行作为一条规则，便于逐项比较。常见列式决策表把规则放在列上，表达的是同一组关系。

Each combination needs a clear action:members free in both rows;nonmembers free above threshold and8 below it. Our display uses one rule per row for comparison; conventional column-oriented decision tables represent the same relationships.
每增加一个独立二值条件，组合数翻倍：两项是4，三项是8。如果会员两行中金额无论真假都不改变运费，可把该条件记为“—（无关）”并合并；保留原行对应关系。“无关”不是“不可能”，也不是删除整条规则。

Each additional independent binary condition doubles combinations:two give4,three give8. If spend does not affect the two member rows,mark it irrelevant (—) and merge while retaining traceability. Irrelevant is not infeasible,and is not deletion of the rule.
会员且满额时，两条免运费条件都成立，但动作同为0，并不冲突。会员未满额时，第一条仍足够；这行能检出把“或者”错误写成“而且”的实现。
For a member above threshold,both conditions hold and agree on zero. Below threshold,membership alone is enough. That row detects an incorrect AND in place of OR.
非会员满额由第二条覆盖；只有“非会员且未满额”使用默认运费8。选中右侧某一行，检查它的两个判断值、适用句子与结果能否一一对应。
Nonmembers above threshold use the second rule;only nonmembers below it pay8. Select a row and trace both conditions,the applicable sentence and the resulting action.
若两条规则在同一组合下要求不同动作，就需要先澄清优先级或冲突，不应由测试者猜。记录未知，比默默给一个看似合理的答案更有价值。
If two rules demand different actions for the same combination,clarify priority/conflict first. Record the unknown rather than guessing an apparently reasonable result.

title: 在阈值附近找遗漏
Inspect the threshold
lead: 组合检查解决“哪些情况”，边界检查解决“刚好到哪里”。
Combinations identify cases;boundaries identify exact cutoffs.
paragraphs: 固定非会员，分别试99、100、101元。预期运费8、0、0。若实现把>=100写成>100，刚好100元会出错，而只测99和101发现不了。
For a nonmember,try99,100,101:expected fees8,0,0. If >=100 becomes >100,the exact100 case fails while99 and101 both look correct.
这不是用三笔订单代替整个决策表，而是在四组合外补一组端点检查。金额允许小数还是整数、负数和空值如何处理，也要由契约确定；本例只处理非负整数金额。
These three amounts supplement,not replace,the decision table. Decimal,negative and missing-value behavior needs a contract;this example uses nonnegative integers only.
复核时先看组合是否唯一、是否遗漏，再看动作和边界。练习的系统反馈会定位到某一行；你仍需要说明为什么那一行应这样处理。
Check uniqueness/completeness before actions and boundaries. Practice feedback identifies a row,but you still explain why that action follows.

title: 核对理解，进入新规则练习
Check understanding,then practice new policies
lead: 在新阈值上独立填写，而不是抄四个数字。
Apply the logic at a new threshold rather than copying numbers.
paragraphs: 先回答右侧检查：会员未满额应不应该收运费？说明依据后进入练习。练习会改变阈值与费用，并分开保存基础应用、错误排查和独立综合。
Answer the check:should a member below threshold pay shipping? Then practice at changed thresholds/fees,with separate application,debugging and independent records.
系统能核对本题四行及指定端点是否符合规则，这只说明本份材料的答案一致。最终检验仍是独立的课程情境任务，不是实际系统测试或全面能力认证。

The system checks four rows and the specified endpoint against this policy. That establishes consistency for this material only. Final course scenarios remain separate from real-system testing or broad certification.

checkTopics: 无关条件与可追踪合并
二值条件组合的书面计算

opening: 下一班接手时，哪些话可以相信？
What can the next responder rely on?

title: 从一份含糊交接开始
Start with an ambiguous handoff
lead: “两台都感染了，已经处理”为什么不能直接交接？
Why is “both infected,handled” an unreliable handoff?
paragraphs: 你不需要先会取证工具。先学把观察到的事实、据此提出的假设以及还没检查的内容分开。合成情境中，日志L17只显示H1在02:00Z超时，H2尚未检查；H1隔离有批准A7和回执R2。 Z表示UTC时间。隔离指临时限制访问，批准与执行回执分别说明允许做和已经做。

You do not need forensic tools to begin. Separate observations,hypotheses and unexamined scope. Synthetic logL17 shows H1 timeout at02:00Z;H2 is unexamined. H1 isolation has approvalA7 and receiptR2. Z denotes UTC. Isolation temporarily restricts access;approval and execution receipts establish permission and completion separately.
“H1超时”有日志支持，“H1受感染”还没有；“H2没发现问题”也不能改写为“H2安全”。未知不是零，也不是已经受影响。接手者需要知道结论的证据边界。
The log supports H1 timeout,not yet infection. Unexamined H2 cannot be called safe. Unknown is neither zero nor confirmed impact. The recipient needs the evidence boundary.
点选右侧证据，观察它能支持哪句话、不能支持哪句话。这里仅做离线合成材料练习，不会连接或隔离真实主机。
Select evidence to see what it supports and what it cannot establish. This is offline synthetic practice;it connects to or isolates no real host.
先写观察内容、对象和UTC时间，再引用材料编号。L17支持超时这一事实；R2支持隔离动作已经执行。批准A7只说明处置被允许，不单独证明动作成功。
Write observation,asset and UTC time,then the reference. L17 supports timeout;R2 supports executed isolation. ApprovalA7 authorizes an action but does not by itself prove execution.
把假设另列为“待验证”，例如依赖超时或主机问题，并给下一步需要的证据。不要把一个错误码直接升级成根因，也不要删掉与猜测不一致的日志。
Keep hypotheses explicitly pending,such as dependency timeout or host trouble,and state the next evidence needed. A code is not a root cause;retain contradictory evidence too.
记录和证据本身也需要保护。实际工作按组织权限、保存期限与证据流程处理；本课只练习引用与判断边界，不声称完成正式取证或法律证据链。
Protect records/evidence under organizational access,retention and evidence procedures. This lesson practices references and reasoning limits,not formal forensics or legal chain of custody.

title: 写成能继续行动的交接
Write an actionable handoff
lead: 事实之外，还要有下一步、责任和更新时间。
Add next steps,ownership and an update time.
paragraphs: 将确认事实、证据引用、未知范围、已做/待做动作分开。这样后续发现新线索时，只需更新相应项，不会把整个叙事一起推翻。右侧示例保留H2未检查，而不是追求一个完整却不真实的结论。

Separate facts,references,unknowns and completed/planned actions. New evidence can update one part without rewriting a misleading narrative. The example retains unexamined H2 instead of inventing completeness.
待办要让另一人能接住：例如“值班乙在02:20Z前核对H2日志并更新范围”。“尽快处理”没有对象、责任或下一次反馈点，不能当作可执行交接。
Make follow-up assignable:Responder B checks H2 logs by02:20Z and updates scope. “Handle ASAP” lacks an asset,owner and update point.
给接手者读一遍，询问他能否复述当前确认范围、尚未知什么、下一步由谁做。不能复述的部分就是需要补清楚的位置。
Read it to a recipient and ask them to reconstruct confirmed scope,unknowns and ownership. Anything they cannot reconstruct needs clarification.

title: 处置前核对权限与影响
Check authority and impact
lead: 升级不是把语气写得更严重，而是把需要决策的事说明白。
Escalation clarifies needed decisions rather than amplifying language.
paragraphs: 若要临时限制访问，先明确批准人、对象、业务影响、验证方法与回退条件。已隔离H1并不自动授权隔离H2；也不能因为希望尽快恢复就绕过批准范围。
Before restricting access,declare approver,asset,business impact,verification and rollback. Isolation of H1 does not authorize H2,and urgency does not widen authority.
区分“已执行”“待批准”“计划中”。动作完成后仍要检查效果；批准记录、执行回执、业务恢复证据分别回答不同问题。
Distinguish executed,pending approval and planned. After action,verify effect:approval,execution receipt and business recovery evidence answer different questions.
练习里的结构检查只核对字段、材料引用和时间格式，不能判定你推断的根因是否真实。参考记录与本人复核分开呈现，最终检验再检查证据、权限和确认范围的判断。

Practice structure checks validate fields,references,time format,not the truth of your root-cause reasoning. Reference comparison and self-review stay separate;final checks address evidence,authority and confirmed scope.

title: 核对证据边界，进入交接练习
Check evidence limits,then practice handoffs
lead: 让接手者清楚知道“已知什么、还要做什么”。
Help the recipient know what is established and what remains.
paragraphs: 先完成右侧证据边界检查，再进入分字段的交接练习。独立任务换为订单查询超时：你要保留日志L17，明确根因未知，并写负责人和下一次UTC更新时间。
Complete the evidence-boundary check,then practice in structured fields. The independent case is an order-query timeout:retain L17,keep root cause unknown and name owner/next UTC update.
保存记录只表示已有可回看的产物。参考对照不能替代组织的正式响应流程；通过三项课程题也不能推导出具备真实事件处置的全部能力。
Saving creates a reviewable artifact. References do not replace organizational response procedures,and three course items do not establish complete real-incident competence.

checkTopics: 访问限制的授权与回退
已确认与未知范围的区别
